component.name: Solvetus VPN Manager
component.summary: Manage an existing OpenVPN subscription through NetworkManager

description.p: Solvetus VPN Manager is an independent GTK4/libadwaita front end for an existing FastVPN/OpenVPN subscription. It downloads the provider's public server catalogue, validates every profile strictly, and imports the selected profile through NetworkManager and its OpenVPN plugin.

The application runs as an ordinary user. NetworkManager performs all privileged network operations. Passwords are handled by the NetworkManager secret agent and are never written into the VPN profile.
This is an early test build. It manages one reusable NetworkManager profile. It does not provide a kill switch, auto-protect, DNS filtering, or background reconnection.
